dishes.name: Ceviche Carretillero

Fresh mahi mahi marinated in a vibrant ají amarillo leche de tigre, topped with crispy fried calamari for that perfect coastal crunch. Served with classic sides: cancha, sweet potato, and salsa criolla, just like on the streets of Lima.

dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaína
dishes.description: Savor our beloved appetizer featuring tender slices of boiled potatoes smothered in our creamy, house-made Huancaína sauce, a rich blend of Peruvian aji amarillo, queso fresco, milk, and spices. Topped with shredded boiled egg and olives.

dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: Peru's iconic stir-fry! Juicy strips of beef sautéed with red onions, tomatoes, and golden Peruvian-style fries, wok-tossed in soy sauceand native spices. Served with fluffy white rice. Also available in chicken or veggie options (mushrooms).

dishes.name: Tallarin a la Huancaina with Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: A unique combination of flavors, this dish pairs our signature Huancaína sauce, a creamy and slightly spicy blend of ají amarillo and cheese, with noodles and tender strips of beef. It's a comforting and delicious twist of traditional pasta.

dishes.name: Tallarin Saltado
dishes.description: Peruvian stir-fried noodles with your choice of beef, chicken, or mushrooms, onions and tomatoes, seasoned with soy sauce and spices.

dishes.name: Tallarines Verdes (Peruvian Pasta)
dishes.description: When Italian immigrants came to Peru, they brought with them the love for pesto. Peruvians made it their own by blending basil with spinach and queso fresco, creating a uniquely Peruvian salsa verde. With serve this with lomo saltado on top.

dishes.name: Aji de Gallina
dishes.description: Indulge in this classic Peruvian dish, a true comfort food delight. Tender shredded chicken in a creamy, mildly spicy sauce made with ají amarillo peppers, cheese, and walnuts. Served over a bed of steamed rice and potatoes, garnished with olives and hard-boiled eggs. *Contains Nuts.*
